purpose: Reuse bounded methodological patterns from Tranception without claiming its protein-language-model results as TOPA evidence or JANUS-original science.

adopted_patterns.topa_mapping: Combine a baseline model with source-bound local evidence while keeping contributions separable.
If a retrieved prior is absent or inapplicable, do not fabricate it; fall back to the bounded baseline.
Reject malformed identity, range, source-state or non-finite observations before anomaly scoring.
Forward/reverse scoring can reduce directional bias but does not imply backwards causation or precognition.
A single favorable metric must not be the sole promotion gate when orthogonal metrics are available.
Average mechanism performance does not prove that the mechanism explains every individual survivor.

repository_drift_controls.detail: An indel example references ProteinGym_reference_file_indels_speedups.csv although that file is absent from the frozen tree.
An indel performance example uses a substitutions-folder variable while running in indel mode.
